positiveTests: profileSelection reports network as a Desktop-profile high-risk capability with android.permission.INTERNET
controlled fetch/http/net/tls/dns facades keep documented diagnostics under existing P13-29/P13-30 tests
raw Node dns/dns-promises/http/https/net/tls native builtins are available only when autojs.nodejs.rawNetworkModules.experimental=true
negativeTests: Safe profile keeps raw network disabled by default
server/listen, DNS resolution, raw socket connect, unsupported schemes, and credential-bearing URLs reject without leaking secrets
abuseCases: credential redaction in denied URL diagnostics

positiveTests: scoped working-directory reads/writes and advanced fs APIs work inside the project root
filesystemProfile reports additionalRoots as empty and rawFd as false
negativeTests: absolute paths, parent traversal, NUL paths, /proc, /sys, /dev, symlink, and realpath escapes reject
watchers and streams must close without pending scoped resources
abuseCases: symlink escape to app cache sibling
capabilities.rollback: Keep filesystemProfile.additionalRoots empty and require explicit future root authorization.

positiveTests: debug experimental provider can call allowlisted java.lang.Math and manage JSON-safe Android handles
profileSelection and featureFlags report Java interop as high-risk disabled by default
negativeTests: default Java module require/resolve is denied and cannot be shadowed
Runtime.exec, ProcessBuilder, ClassLoader, reflection, System.loadLibrary, denied mutation, and released handles reject
capabilities.rollback: Keep NODEJS_JAVA_INTEROP_EXPERIMENTAL_ENABLED false in release and reject project/package overrides.

positiveTests: separate shell bridge remains available only with shell capability
negativeTests: child_process and node:child_process require/resolve are denied and cannot be shadowed
raw process handles, spawn/fork, detached mode, signals, and fd streams remain unavailable
capabilities.rollback: Keep child_process builtin disabled and route command execution through the scoped shell bridge only.

positiveTests: nativeAddonProfile documents signed packaged-only artifact requirements
package integrity policy covers native addon artifacts before any promotion
negativeTests: .node require/resolve, process.dlopen, process.binding, _linkedBinding, node-gyp artifacts, and downloaded native payloads reject
capabilities.rollback: Keep native addon loading denied until signed packaged artifacts, ABI/hash allowlists, dependency scan, and crash isolation land.

positiveTests: inspectorProfile documents debug-only ADB forwarding, user action, and redaction requirements
negativeTests: inspector and node:inspector require/resolve are denied and cannot be shadowed
DevTools attach, protocol sessions, CPU/heap artifacts, remote sockets, and release builds remain unavailable
capabilities.rollback: Keep inspector disabled outside future debug-only sessions with explicit user action.

positiveTests: pure WebAssembly remains available without raw WASI authority
wasiProfile documents scoped/authorized preopen and fd/env/args requirements
negativeTests: wasi and node:wasi require/resolve are denied and cannot be shadowed
raw preopens, host path access, inherited fd numbers, unrestricted env/args, network, and process exit remain denied
capabilities.rollback: Keep raw WASI denied until a controlled facade proves scoped preopens, virtual fds, env/args, resources, worker, and packaged behavior.
